rule: gwz-git spawns only the Git CLI route of native commit and tag, reads no process environment, holds no process-global mutable state and sets no libgit2 process-wide option; the list holds only the Git CLI route of native commit and tag, moved from gwz-core in step 5.2 of GwzTransportReleaseConvergencePlan (5.1b made the list and proved it empty). It is the allowlist of gwz-core's scripts/checks/check_process_globals.py, in the style of process_globals_allowlist_gwz_transport.json: run `python3.13 -B <gwz-core>/scripts/checks/check_process_globals.py --repo <gwz-git> --allowlist <gwz-git>/scripts/process_globals_allowlist.json` (no build, every platform branch is read as source). A new occurrence fails and a listed one that disappears fails, so the list only shrinks. gwz-core's scripts/run_tests.py runs the check over the gwz-git checkout beside it, with this file. 'debt', 'permanent', 'owner' and 'imposed_by' mean what the rule of gwz-core's scripts/checks/process_globals_allowlist.json says.

entries.name: Command::new("git")
entries.reason: git commit, git tag and git tag -d (the Git CLI route of native commit and tag, moved from gwz-core's repository.rs and refs.rs) inherit the live process environment; spawn them with env_clear() plus the caller's GitEnvironment snapshot (GwzCoreSessionDesign RemPlan-1, Safety P3-11). The child is launched through the caller's ProcessGate, so the host's spawn gate (D25) holds the spawn.
